description:
Every plan-producing entry point in the repository-materialization module returns a typed `ProducerError`, so producer failures no longer stringify through `RepositoryStateError::Producer(String)`.

## Background

Producer failures currently stringify through `RepositoryStateError::Producer(String)` and are re-typed by a runtime downcast chain, so exit-code correctness depends on a downcast that silently degrades when a new producer error type appears. This task introduces the typed producer family and retypes the producer surfaces; the exhaustive exit-code match and the module-wide sweep of residual untyped errors are separate work.

1. New `ProducerError` (thiserror), each variant carrying its typed source: `MissingCapture(&'static str)`, `MalformedUtf8(#[from] FromUtf8Error)`, `UnknownProjection(String)`, `UnknownKind { projection, kind }`, plus transparent `#[from]` for `CaptureError`, `RepositoryLayoutError`, `ConfigurationDeclarationError`, `InvariantConfigError`, `ItemError`, `RuleConfigError`, `ProjectionError`, `ManagedDocumentError`. The six `materialize.rs` producers (`read_text`, `assemble_config`, `assemble_config_from_declarations`, `render_capture_closure`, `validate_capture_closure`, `compose_configured_projections`) and the two internal `anyhow` leaves - `render_projection_body` in `projection_render.rs` (whose injected read-closure becomes `FnMut(&str) -> Result<Option<String>, ProducerError>`) and `validate_proposed_layout` in `artifact_classifier.rs` - return `Result<_, ProducerError>`.
2. `RepositoryStateError::Producer(String)` becomes `Producer(#[from] ProducerError)`. The stringifying `producer`/`projection_producer` sink helpers and the `.map_err(...producer...)` sites in `mod.rs` are replaced with `?`. The inline `Producer(format!)` sites become `ProducerError::ConfigParse` and a new `RepositoryStateError::Overlay(#[from] OverlayError)`. The profile-application producers in `profile_apply.rs` retype with profile-specific variants - `ProfileRegistryNotFile { target }`, `ProfileRegistryParse { target, #[source] source }`, `ProfileContributionConflict { identity, registry }`.

The exit-code boundary in `main.rs` is left unchanged; the profile-target-conflict predicate keeps returning the same boolean against the typed representation so the binary still compiles. Rewriting that boundary into an exhaustive match is out of scope here.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `ProducerError` exists with the variants above, and `RepositoryStateError::Producer` carries `#[from] ProducerError`.
- [hard] REQ-02: The six `materialize.rs` producers, `render_projection_body`, and `validate_proposed_layout` return `Result<_, ProducerError>`; the stringifying producer sink helpers and their `.map_err` sites are replaced with `?`.
- [hard] REQ-03: The profile-application producers in `profile_apply.rs` return typed profile-specific variants rather than `Producer(String)`.
- [hard] REQ-04: For the surfaces retyped here, `String`-typed variant fields hold raw identifiers and message rendering lives in `Display` impls rather than `format!`-constructed values.
- [hard] REQ-05: Existing behavior and exit codes are preserved; the failure-path tests pass unchanged.

## Notes

Retyping the two finalizers and the exhaustive exit-code mapping are separate work. The profile-target-conflict predicate is retained here, adapted to the typed variant, so the exit boundary continues to compile.
title: Typed producer error family for repository-state
